scope: M8 supplies the deterministic multilingual gate. The orchestrator requires allow/clarify/refuse and fails closed before encoding, retrieval, worker, or web action for every other result.
locale: Only the exact active request locale reaches the E5 encoder/retriever. A returned different locale is an abstention; cross-locale merge, retry, and ordinary search are forbidden.
evidence: Only M5 answer-ready same-locale EvidencePack context reaches the worker. Empty, stale, contradictory, low-confidence, over-budget, invalid, or unavailable evidence does not invoke generation. Several current citable local topics may be packed together; scope ambiguity is decided before retrieval.
generation: The exact M6 worker receives bounded JSON Lines evidence. M7-04 supplies the parser/support checker; absent or invalid output fails closed and no raw model text is returned.
citation: An answer requires nonempty text and unique citation IDs that are a subset of the accepted local evidence citations. The orchestration layer resolves no user/model URL and never returns internal chunk/vector/score fields.
web: request_web runs only after scope admission and is an explicit non-network placeholder until M9; it returns assistant_web_not_available without encoding, retrieval, worker, or provider calls.
ordinary_search: The deterministic documentation search is neither imported, called, ranked, nor changed by this module.
